Purpose: a manually-verified reference to benchmark `nuguard sbom generate
--config nuguard.yaml` output against for this app — did the extractor find
the real agent/model/tool/datastore/auth surface documented here. This is
NOT nuguard-generated output; every node's evidence.location was verified
against the source cloned locally from the `main` branch (./repo, gitignored).
shop-chat-agent is a Shopify-embedded reference app (React Router backend +
a Shopify theme-extension chat widget) that turns a storefront into a
Claude-powered shopping assistant speaking the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
against Shopify's own storefront and customer-account MCP servers.

metadata.description: handleChatSession() drives a multi-turn Claude tool-use loop (streamConversation, looping until stop_reason === 'end_turn'), dispatching MCP tool calls (mcpClient.callTool) between turns and persisting history via Prisma. Not built on LangGraph/CrewAI/AutoGen — the orchestration loop is plain application code directly calling the Anthropic SDK and an MCP JSON-RPC client.

evidence.detail: while (finalMessage.stop_reason !== "end_turn") { finalMessage = await claudeService.streamConversation({ messages, promptType, tools: mcpClient.tools }, { onToolUse: async (content) => { ... mcpClient.callTool(toolName, toolArgs) ... } }) }
System prompt selection: getSystemPrompt(promptType) reads app/prompts/prompts.json

metadata.description: createClaudeService() wraps @anthropic-ai/sdk directly (new Anthropic({apiKey})), calling anthropic.messages.stream() with a hardcoded model string and max_tokens. No LiteLLM/gateway abstraction — Anthropic is the sole, hardcoded provider.

evidence.detail: const anthropic = new Anthropic({ apiKey }); const stream = await anthropic.messages.stream({ model: AppConfig.api.defaultModel, max_tokens: AppConfig.api.maxTokens, ... })

metadata.description: MCPClient.connectToStorefrontServer()/callStorefrontTool() proxy Claude tool calls as JSON-RPC (tools/list, tools/call) to Shopify's storefront MCP endpoint (${hostUrl}/api/mcp). No auth required — storefront MCP tools (search_shop_catalog, update_cart, get_cart, search_shop_policies_and_faqs) are reachable by any visitor of the storefront domain.
metadata.descriptive_name: Storefront MCP Tool Proxy (product search, cart, policies)

evidence.detail: this.storefrontMcpEndpoint = `${hostUrl}/api/mcp`; async callStorefrontTool(toolName, toolArgs) { ... this._makeJsonRpcRequest(this.storefrontMcpEndpoint, "tools/call", { name: toolName, arguments: toolArgs }, headers) }

metadata.description: MCPClient.connectToCustomerServer()/callCustomerTool() proxy Claude tool calls to Shopify's customer-account MCP endpoint (${accountHostUrl}/customer/api/mcp), which requires a customer OAuth access token (get_most_recent_order_status, get_order_status). No token means the tool call responds with an auth_required error that triggers the PKCE auth flow (auth.server.js) rather than failing outright — effectively invocable without prior authentication.
metadata.descriptive_name: Customer Account MCP Tool Proxy (orders, returns)

evidence.detail: async callCustomerTool(toolName, toolArgs) { let accessToken = this.customerAccessToken; if (!accessToken) { const dbToken = await getCustomerToken(this.conversationId); ... } }

metadata.description: Prisma ORM against a local SQLite file (file:dev.sqlite). Tables: Session (Shopify OAuth session incl. accessToken), CustomerToken (customer OAuth access/refresh tokens per conversation), CodeVerifier (PKCE state), Conversation/Message (full chat history), CustomerAccountUrls (per-conversation MCP/auth URLs). Stores live OAuth access tokens in plaintext columns.

evidence.detail: datasource db { provider = "sqlite" url = "file:dev.sqlite" } — models Session, CustomerToken, CodeVerifier, Conversation, Message, CustomerAccountUrls

metadata.description: shopifyApp() (from @shopify/shopify-app-react-router) configures standard Shopify Admin OAuth for the embedded /app/* admin UI and webhook authentication, backed by PrismaSessionStorage. authPathPrefix '/auth'.

evidence.detail: const shopify = shopifyApp({ apiKey: process.env.SHOPIFY_API_KEY, apiSecretKey: process.env.SHOPIFY_API_SECRET, scopes: process.env.SCOPES?.split(","), authPathPrefix: "/auth", sessionStorage: new PrismaSessionStorage(prisma), distribution: AppDistribution.AppStore })
export const loader = async ({ request }) => { await authenticate.admin(request); return null; }

metadata.description: auth.server.js implements OAuth2 Authorization Code + PKCE against Shopify's Customer Account API to obtain a customer access token scoped to customer-account-mcp-api:full — grants the assistant order-history/returns access on the shopper's behalf.

evidence.detail: export async function generateAuthUrl(conversationId, shopId) { const scope = "customer-account-mcp-api:full"; const verifier = generateCodeVerifier(); const challenge = await generateCodeChallenge(verifier); await storeCodeVerifier(state, verifier); ... }

metadata.description: Primary agent entry point. GET with ?history=true returns JSON conversation history; GET with Accept: text/event-stream or POST starts a Claude tool-use turn streamed as server-sent events. No authentication required — shopId/shopDomain are read from client-supplied X-Shopify-Shop-Id/Origin headers, not verified server-side.

evidence.detail: export async function loader({ request }) { ... if (request.headers.get("Accept") === "text/event-stream") return handleChatRequest(request); } export async function action({ request }) { return handleChatRequest(request); }

metadata.description: Verified Shopify webhook receiver (authenticate.webhook) — on APP_UNINSTALLED, deletes all Session rows for the shop.

evidence.detail: export const action = async ({ request }) => { const { shop, session, topic } = await authenticate.webhook(request); switch (topic) { case 'APP_UNINSTALLED': ... db.session.deleteMany({where: {shop}}) } }

metadata.description: Shopify-embedded admin route rendered inside the Shopify Admin iframe via App Bridge; guarded by authenticate.admin() through Shopify's OAuth session.

evidence.detail: app.jsx loader calls authenticate.admin(request); app._index.jsx renders the Polaris <s-page> admin UI

metadata.description: Dockerfile builds the React Router app for production (npm ci --omit=dev, npm run build) and runs `npm run docker-start` (prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && react-router-serve).

evidence.detail: FROM node:18-alpine ... EXPOSE 3000 ... RUN npm ci --omit=dev ... RUN npm run build ... CMD ["npm", "run", "docker-start"]

metadata.description: shopify.app.toml declares an embedded, App Store-distributed app with unauthenticated_read_product_listings access scope and OAuth/customer-account redirect URLs; deployed via `shopify app deploy` (Shopify CLI), not a generic cloud IaC target.

edges.detail: Conversation loop calls Claude for every turn
onToolUse dispatches storefront tool calls via MCPClient
onToolUse dispatches customer tool calls via MCPClient
Customer MCP tool calls require a PKCE-issued customer access token
Admin UI guarded by Shopify Admin OAuth session
Shopify App Store deployment runs the built container image
